## History

Magog was one of Aunt Jamesina's cats who moved into Patty's Place alongside her owner and another cat named Gog. Later, Magog caused unexpected chaos during an unannounced visit from [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) Gardner's mother and sisters. Despite the disruptions caused by the cats, the visit ultimately ended successfully.
